# Teachers Pay Teachers

> Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) is a digital marketplace where educators discover, share, and purchase high-quality teaching materials, lesson plans, and classroom resources across all grade levels and subject areas.

TPT connects millions of teachers with vetted educational resources including lesson plans, worksheets, assessments, and classroom supplies. The platform supports both digital delivery and print-at-home options, with gift cards available for easy purchasing and sharing.

## Key Topics

- lesson plans
- curriculum resources
- teaching materials

## Browse & Discover Resources

- [All Resources | TPT](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse): Browse all educational resources across subjects and grades on TPT marketplace with filtering and search capabilities

## Gift Cards & Purchasing

- [TPT Gift Cards](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Gift-Card): Purchase digital or print-at-home gift cards for TPT educational resources with email delivery options

## Optional

- [Security | TPT](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/security): TPT security standards including HTTPS, TLS 1.2, and vulnerability scanning
